translated_title: Mexico Rejects Considering Nicaragua’s Situation a Regional Threat at the OAS
original_title: México rechaza considerar crisis de Nicaragua una amenaza regional ante la OEA
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Iván Saldaña
meta_description: Mexico’s representative Alejandro Encinas rejected labeling Nicaragua’s situation a regional security threat, warning it could “deepen isolation” and exceed the OAS’s powers, leading Mexico to abstain on the US-backed resolution.
